gloss: to step on, to tread on

definitions.gloss: to step on, to tread on
definitions.explanation: To place one's foot on something, intentionally or accidentally.
Figuratively, to go through a process or procedure.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{踏|ふ}む (step on X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action or completed state. {踏|ふ}んでいる = 'is stepping on.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{足|あし}を{踏|ふ}む (step on someone's foot)
・ブレーキを{踏|ふ}む (step on the brakes)
・アクセルを{踏|ふ}む (step on the accelerator)
・{手順|てじゅん}を{踏|ふ}む (follow procedure)
・{踏|ふ}み{台|だい} (stepping stool)
・{踏|ふ}み{切|き}り (railroad crossing; decisive action)

IDIOMS:
・{地|じ}を{踏|ふ}む (to set foot on)
・{二|ふた}の{足|あし}を{踏|ふ}む (to hesitate)

PASSIVE USAGE: {踏|ふ}まれる (be stepped on) is common for accidental stepping.
